g.text: B1-G · The actual mixed gallery can reverse the proxy-only ordering
FiQA50 all-paid view · all six methods / both encoder pairs · same frozen fit and paid set at both endpoints
Five-seed means; numbers at right are after − before. Descriptive diagnostics: no intervals or significance tests.
Each fit already saw all 28,819 paid pairs; proxy-only predicts every row, including anchors. Before is a counterfactual.
Inspected DEV; qualified baseline configurations as in B1-P. Full90-condition CSV retained; no causal calibration or cost claim.
